english.notes:
(i) 'Consent' to sharing of a photograph or film includes general consent covering the particular act of sharing as well as specific consent and whether a belief is reasonable is to be determined having regard to all circumstances including any steps the person has taken to ascertain whether the other person consents, see section 66B(6) of the Sexual Offences Act 2003. And it is a defence to this offence to prove a reasonable excuse for sharing the photograph or film, see section 66B(8).
(ii) Three other offences are available under section 66B of the Act: H101571 - Sharing photograph or film of person in intimate state intending to cause alarm distress or humiliation; H101572 - Sharing photograph or film of person in intimate state for the purpose of sexual gratification; H101573 - Threatening to share photograph or film of person in intimate state.(ii) Section 66C provides for exemptions to the offences under this section.

other.penalty:
Summary: maximum 6 months imprisonment and/or a fine.

The maximum penalty depends on the maximum term for summary offences, see section 66B(10) and (11) of this Act; for offences committed before section 281(5) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 comes into force this is 6 months, for offences committed on or after that date 51 weeks.
